bio.text: Ashley Moody was sworn into the U.S. Senate on January 21, 2025, after Governor Ron DeSantis appointed her to the seat.
She served as Florida's Attorney General from 2019 to 2025 and was elected a Circuit Court Judge in Hillsborough County in 2006.
Earlier she worked at Holland & Knight and in the U.S. Attorney's Office.
A native of Plant City, Florida, she earned bachelor's and master's degrees in accounting and a law degree at the University of Florida, and an LL.M. from Stetson University College of Law.
